reusable_findings: Restricting XML seeds to constructors and real View lifecycle removes the demonstrated AdWebView public-method false positives.
Deferred field resolution correctly adds the concrete AdWebView alternative to Novel settings and client registrations, but PatchRedirector alternatives must remain explicit unknown candidates.
A direct call whose receiver is parent-declared but has the same proven XML allocation id should retain the concrete XML type; Support's three settings still miss this propagation.
Tight component seeding must not suppress dynamically dispatched override bodies reached by a real call. Privacy loadUrl reaches X5WrapperWebView and DtX5WebView and conditionally injects bridges.
Nullable fallback allocation requires order/null feasibility. Keeping both the non-null argument and `new` branch without the guard continues to fabricate Support's DtX5 object.
